titleZh: 任务结束后，彗星数据还在带来新视角

sources.title: ESA · Mission complete: Rosetta’s journey ends in daring descent to comet
ESA · Comet jet in 3D（立体影像方法背景）

cet4.title: A Mission Ends, but Learning Continues
cet4.summary: 从 NASA 10 月 17 日的彗星立体影像专题出发，了解旧观测数据为何仍有价值；课堂活动为教学设想。

paragraphs.text: On October 17, 2026, NASA’s Astronomy Picture of the Day featured a three-dimensional view of Comet 67P. Its rough surface seemed to come closer when viewed with suitable red-and-blue glasses. Yet the pictures behind the display were taken by the Rosetta spacecraft on July 25, 2015. The recent feature offered a new encounter with old observations, rather than evidence of another visit to the comet.
paragraphs.translation: 2026 年 10 月 17 日，NASA“每日一天文图”展示了 67P 彗星的立体影像。戴上合适的红蓝眼镜观看时，粗糙的表面仿佛变得更近。然而，这一展示使用的图片由罗塞塔号探测器于 2015 年 7 月 25 日拍摄。本次专题让人们重新接触旧观测，而不是说明有探测器再次造访了彗星。

paragraphs.text: The display was made from two photographs. Putting suitable views together can help people notice depth that is harder to judge in a single flat picture. The value comes from a careful way to combine observations, not from inventing a landscape. An attractive result is more useful when viewers can also understand how it was produced and what the original pictures show.
paragraphs.translation: 这幅影像由两张照片制成。把合适的视图结合起来，能帮助人们察觉单张平面图片中较难判断的深度。其价值来自谨慎组合观测的方法，而不是凭空创造地貌。观看者若还了解制作过程以及原始图片展示的内容，吸引人的效果就会更有用。

paragraphs.text: A separate example shows why keeping records matters. In November 2015, the European Space Agency released an updated shape model of the comet. It included southern regions missing from earlier models. Additional photographs helped build a more complete view. Such work gives a reason to preserve the observations, rather than keeping only the most impressive final image for a short public display.
paragraphs.translation: 另一个例子说明了保存记录为何重要。2015 年 11 月，欧洲航天局发布了更新后的彗星形状模型，其中包含早期模型缺失的南部区域。新增照片帮助形成了更完整的视图。这类工作说明，人们应当保存观测资料，而不能只为短暂展示保留最引人注目的最终图片。

paragraphs.text: Rosetta’s mission ended on September 30, 2016, with a controlled impact on the comet. The spacecraft could no longer send back new observations. However, the information already returned remained available for study. The end of collecting data was not the end of asking questions. A well-kept record can connect work done years ago with people who are beginning to learn today.
paragraphs.translation: 罗塞塔任务于 2016 年 9 月 30 日以受控撞击彗星的方式结束，探测器此后无法再传回新观测。然而，已经传回的信息仍可用于研究。停止收集数据不等于停止提出问题。保存良好的记录能把多年前完成的工作与今天刚开始学习的人联系起来。

paragraphs.text: For a classroom activity, imagine students drawing a familiar object from different positions. Comparing the drawings could show what each view reveals and leaves hidden. They could record their method and explain which conclusion the evidence supports. This exercise would encourage a useful perspective: learning sometimes advances because we return to existing material with a better question, not simply because we collect something new.
paragraphs.translation: 设想一项课堂活动：学生从不同位置画同一件熟悉的物品。比较图画可以看出，各个视图展示了什么、又隐藏了什么。他们可以记录方法，并说明证据支持哪种结论。这项练习能培养一种有用的视角：学习有时通过带着更好的问题重看现有材料而进步，而不只是依靠收集新材料。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指组合影像呈现的前后空间关系，而非图片在屏幕上的厚度。

examples.text: The shadows gave the drawing a sense of depth.
examples.translation: 阴影让这幅画有了纵深感。

examples.text: From this angle, it is easier to judge the depth of the valley.
examples.translation: 从这个角度更容易判断山谷的深度。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指保存原始观测资料，让后来的研究和学习可以继续使用。

examples.text: The library works to preserve letters written by local residents.
examples.translation: 图书馆致力于保存当地居民写下的信件。

examples.text: We preserved the original notes so others could check the method.
examples.translation: 我们保存了原始笔记，供其他人核查方法。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指理解学习进步的一种角度：更好的问题也能让旧材料产生价值。

examples.text: The discussion gave me a different perspective on the problem.
examples.translation: 这次讨论让我有了看待问题的不同视角。

examples.text: Reading the diary offers a personal perspective on village life.
examples.translation: 阅读这本日记能从个人视角了解乡村生活。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A mission’s value depends mainly on its latest photograph.
Preserved observations can support learning after a mission ends.
Three-dimensional displays have replaced scientific questions.
Old observations are useful only for public entertainment.
questions.explanation: 全文从旧照片的立体展示、模型更新写到任务结束后的研究与课堂学习，中心是保存的观测可以持续产生价值，因此选 B。A 将价值局限于最新照片，D 则把学习和研究误缩为娱乐。

questions.prompt: What does the passage say about the pictures featured in October 2026?
options: They were taken during a new visit to the comet.
They were collected after the end of the mission.
They were captured by Rosetta in July 2015.
They showed a landscape invented for the display.
questions.explanation: 第一段明确区分专题展示日期与拍摄日期：2026 年的专题使用 2015 年 7 月的照片，C 是相应转述。A 把重新展示误当成再次造访，B 与任务结束时间不符。

questions.prompt: How did the updated shape model described in paragraph 3 improve on earlier models?
options: It included regions that had previously been missing.
It removed photographs to create a simpler display.
It recorded a new spacecraft landing in the south.
It replaced the comet’s surface with a familiar object.
questions.explanation: 第三段指出更新模型加入了早期模型缺失的南部区域，A 对这一改进作了概括。B 与增加照片的作用相反；C 把模型覆盖范围的扩展误解为新着陆。

questions.prompt: What would best support the purpose of the proposed classroom activity?
options: Selecting the drawing with the most attractive colours.
Replacing the drawings when they disagree with one another.
Keeping the conclusion while leaving the method unrecorded.
Explaining what different views can and cannot establish.
questions.explanation: 第五段要求比较各视图显示与隐藏的内容，并记录方法和证据，因此 D 最符合活动目的。A 只评价外观，B 回避差异，C 则省略了使结论可核查的过程。

questions.prompt: The word “preserve” in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to _____.
options: predict
replace
keep safe for later use
make more impressive
questions.explanation: 上下文将保存观测与只留下最终展示图片进行对比，目的是让资料供后续使用，因此 preserve 在此为“妥善保存”，选 C。D 混淆了保存资料与美化展示。

cet6.title: The Afterlife of a Scientific Archive
cet6.summary: 由近期彗星影像专题讨论数据、模型与研究档案的持续价值，区分历史事实与课堂推演。

paragraphs.text: A spacecraft can cease operating while its observations continue to reach new audiences. NASA’s Astronomy Picture of the Day illustrated this on October 17, 2026, by featuring a three-dimensional representation of Comet 67P. The paired photographs had been acquired by Rosetta in July 2015. Their return to public attention demonstrates that a recent presentation need not depend on a recent expedition: existing observations can be encountered through a different form.
paragraphs.translation: 探测器可以停止运行，其观测资料却仍能触及新的受众。2026 年 10 月 17 日，NASA“每日一天文图”展示 67P 彗星的立体影像，说明了这一点。配对照片由罗塞塔号于 2015 年 7 月获取。它们重新进入公众视野表明，近期的展示未必依赖近期的探测行动：现有观测也可以通过不同形式被重新接触。

paragraphs.text: The transformation matters because a representation influences what becomes noticeable. Combining appropriate photographs into a stereo view can make spatial relationships easier to appreciate than in one flat image. This does not mean that processing automatically creates additional evidence. It changes the way recorded information is presented. A responsible interpretation therefore asks both what the display helps reveal and how its connection to the underlying observations can be checked.
paragraphs.translation: 这种转换很重要，因为呈现形式影响哪些内容容易被注意到。把合适的照片组合成立体视图，可以使空间关系比在单张平面图片中更容易被理解。这并不意味着处理过程会自动创造额外证据，而是改变了记录信息的呈现方式。因此，负责任的理解既要问展示有助于揭示什么，也要问如何核查它与基础观测的联系。

paragraphs.text: An earlier archive release provides a complementary example. In November 2015, ESA announced an updated shape model incorporating previously absent southern regions of the comet. The expansion depended on additional images, showing that the coverage of a model reflects the material available to construct it. An incomplete model is not necessarily worthless; its limitations identify where further observations or analysis may matter. The example concerns that historical update, not a newly announced model in 2026.
paragraphs.translation: 一次较早的档案发布提供了互补的例子。2015 年 11 月，欧洲航天局公布了纳入彗星此前缺失的南部区域的更新形状模型。覆盖范围的扩展依赖新增图片，说明模型覆盖程度取决于用于构建它的材料。不完整的模型不一定没有价值；它的局限指出了哪些地方可能需要更多观测或分析。这个例子指的是历史上的更新，而非 2026 年刚公布的新模型。

paragraphs.text: The operational boundary is equally clear. Rosetta’s mission concluded with a controlled impact on September 30, 2016. New transmissions from the spacecraft could no longer be requested, yet its returned data remained a resource for scientific work. Preservation thus protects an opportunity that cannot simply be recreated on demand. It requires more than retaining a polished public picture: the records needed to understand previous work must remain usable as well.
paragraphs.translation: 任务运行的边界同样明确。罗塞塔任务于 2016 年 9 月 30 日以受控撞击结束。人们无法再要求探测器传回新数据，但已传回的数据仍是科学工作的资源。因此，保存资料保护的是一种无法随时重现的机会。这不仅需要保留精美的公众展示图片，也需要让理解此前工作所需的记录继续可用。

paragraphs.text: Consider a hypothetical student project using photographs of an ordinary object. One group might create an appealing reconstruction while another records camera positions, dates and the steps used to combine views. The second record makes its provenance easier to examine, even if the final display is less dramatic. Comparing the two would help students distinguish an attractive result from a traceable one. It would also show why missing information should be described rather than quietly filled with confident guesses.
paragraphs.translation: 设想一个利用普通物品照片的学生项目。一组学生可能做出吸引人的重建图，另一组则记录相机位置、日期和组合视图的步骤。即便第二组的最终展示不那么夺目，其记录也使来源更容易核查。比较两者有助于学生区分吸引人的成果与来源可追溯的成果，也能说明为什么应交代缺失信息，而不是悄悄用自信的猜测填补。

paragraphs.text: Scientific progress is consequently cumulative in a practical sense. Later work becomes possible partly because earlier observations can still be located, understood and questioned. New instruments remain important, but novelty is not the only source of intellectual value. A better comparison, a clearer method or a new learner can change what existing material makes possible. The archive connects the end of an expedition with the beginning of further inquiry, provided that its contents remain intelligible beyond their original setting. A lost method can make a surviving file difficult to interpret, so keeping explanations is part of keeping the knowledge useful.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，科学进步在实际意义上具有累积性。后来的工作之所以能够开展，部分原因是早先的观测仍可被找到、理解和质疑。新仪器依然重要，但新颖性不是知识价值的唯一来源。更好的比较、更清晰的方法或新的学习者，都能改变现有材料带来的可能性。只要档案内容在原有背景之外仍然可以被理解，它就能把一次探测的结束与进一步探究的开始联系起来。遗失方法说明会使仍然保存着的文件难以解读，因此保留解释本身也是保存可用知识的一部分。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指模型已经包含的彗星表面区域，而非媒体对任务的报道。

examples.text: The map has good coverage of the northern coastline.
examples.translation: 这张地图对北部海岸线的覆盖较全面。

examples.text: Additional surveys extended the study’s geographical coverage.
examples.translation: 更多调查扩大了这项研究的地理覆盖范围。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指照片、处理步骤等记录的来源，使项目结果能够被追溯和核查。

examples.text: The museum checked the provenance of the donated painting.
examples.translation: 博物馆核查了捐赠画作的来源。

examples.text: Clear labels help researchers establish the provenance of each sample.
examples.translation: 清楚的标签有助于研究者确定每个样本的来源。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指后来的科学工作建立在能够理解和检验的先前工作之上。

examples.text: Learning is cumulative when each lesson builds on earlier practice.
examples.translation: 当每课都建立在先前练习之上时，学习就具有累积性。

examples.text: The cumulative effect of small improvements became visible over time.
examples.translation: 许多小改进的累积效果逐渐显现出来。

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the author’s central argument?
options: Scientific archives retain value when earlier work remains usable and open to examination.
Scientific progress chiefly requires presenting familiar images in more dramatic ways.
The completion of a mission makes new interpretations more authoritative.
Historical models are most useful when separated from their original observations.
questions.explanation: 全文依次讨论呈现方式、模型覆盖、任务终止和记录可追溯性，最后归结为旧工作可理解、可核查时能支撑后续探究，因此选 A。B 只抓住视觉效果，D 切断了作者反复强调的资料来源联系。

questions.prompt: What does the author clarify about the October 2026 feature?
options: It announced a new mission to acquire additional photographs.
It replaced earlier photographs with a model released in 2026.
It confirmed that Rosetta had resumed transmitting observations.
It presented observations obtained during an earlier period.
questions.explanation: 第一段说明本次专题展示的配对照片采集于 2015 年，D 准确区分展示与采集。A、C 都把旧资料的新呈现误写为探测活动重新开始；B 混淆了专题与第三段的历史模型。

questions.prompt: What lesson does the November 2015 model update illustrate?
options: A model becomes reliable mainly through a more attractive presentation.
A model’s coverage depends on the observations available to build it.
Additional images remove the need to explain a model’s limitations.
Southern regions can be interpreted without reference to earlier records.
questions.explanation: 第三段将新增南部区域与额外图片直接联系起来，说明模型覆盖取决于可用资料，选 B。A 以外观代替资料基础；C 则把改进错误扩大为不再需要说明局限。

questions.prompt: Which project choice would the author most likely favour?
options: Removing uncertain details from the record to make the display persuasive.
Choosing the most polished reconstruction without reviewing its method.
Keeping source details and processing steps even when the result looks less impressive.
Treating a reconstruction as independent evidence once it has been completed.
questions.explanation: 第五段的假设项目肯定记录位置、日期和步骤的可追溯性，因此 C 最符合作者立场。B 只看成品，D 把呈现误当作独立新增证据，与第二段的区分相冲突。

questions.prompt: The word “provenance” in paragraph 5 most nearly refers to _____.
options: the visual complexity of the display
the certainty of every conclusion
the popularity of the final result
the origin and history of the material
questions.explanation: 该词前面列出拍摄位置、日期和组合步骤，后面强调可追溯性，故 provenance 指材料的来源及形成过程，选 D。A、C 属于视觉或传播效果，无法解释为何要保留这些记录。
